name: Yoshikawa Kyouko
source:
Yoshikawa Kyouko is a young woman who works in an info store in the Free City of Kathtom. She runs it alongside her twin sister, [url=/c56548]Yoshikawa Machiko[/url], and the two work hard to provide the most efficient service possible.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Kyouko_Yoshikawa]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
